output.summary: Revisit of PLAY.combat.cover. The 38 existing tests all pass now, including the earlier xfails: T-16 added creature cover. I added 9 green tests to tests/srd/test_playing_the_game.py. They cover creature Half Cover on a diagonal line, on a spell attack, on a Dexterity save inside a Burning Hands cone, and through Session.execute. Under R-09, a Small rat in front of a Large ogre still gives Half Cover. A creature behind the attacker gives none. Creature cover is worked out per attacker, and it protects PCs against monster attacks; object Half Cover on a PC's AC is tested too. I extended the CMB-05 scenario test, which stage B found under-asserting, with the creature-cover check. I also added three cheats to the abuse catalogue. The whole file passes (47 tests), and ruff check and ruff format --check are clean. I didn't add a row to docs/scenario-notes.md, because the instructions only ask for one on a contradicts-srd verdict; the row is ready in scenario_changes if the harness wants it. #8 and #10 (how much of the target an object covers) can't be computed: object cover exists only as a scene label, so I filed both as missing infra. They're tested through the labels.
